}}'''Sillia Cerano''' is the owner and manager of a touring circus that directly competed with  [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Sillia Cerano}}

==Activities==
[[Valan Luca]] is annoyed when he finds out that Sillia has set up her circus at [[Samara]] before he did. He also learns that she has clowns at her circus.{{ref/book|5|36}} Her good fortune does not last long however. When [[Masema Dagar]], self-proclaimed Prophet of the [[Dragon|Lord Dragon]], has Sillia flogged and [[Chin Akima]] beheaded for not leaving Samara fast enough to suit him. In the ensuing chaos, Valan Luca hires the [[Andaya Murasaka|Murasaka]] sisters away from Sillia's show.{{ref/book|5|47}}
